payload.acceptance_criteria: When tracker-path-scan reads vault claim and snapshot events, then the holder name is exempt only where it is the holder (the claim payload name, the snapshot fields.assignee, the existing holder field and created cases), and the same name in any other field or in free text is still refused
payload.description:
## Context
When a development commit runs tracker-path-scan over the vault's pending events, I want the holder name exempt where it is the holder, so a claim does not block every commit. 2026-11-19 ~18:05 UTC the development consumer proof commit (28c76a74) was refused: vault/snapshot.jsonl:13: machine-username; the holder name equals the machine user name, and the scan exempted it only in holder field events and created events. Gate exception decided by the Orchestrator 2026-11-19 18:18 UTC (dev-j6oqo, council run 18:16, 3 voters), bound to dev's exact diff pathscan-final.diff plus a changelog fragment, good until 19:18 UTC. Built by the dev session.
payload.title: tracker-path-scan flags the holder name in vault claim and snapshot events
